domain: Synthetic Biology & Precision Fermentation Food Supply
baseline_dogmas: Synthesizing exact caloric proteins eliminates agricultural land use without nutritional trade-offs.
Centralized bio-reactor fermentation creates resilient, localized food security.
human_blindspots: Generational depletion of complex phytonutrients and soil-microbiome symbiotic diversity
Patent monopsony: five corporations owning the intellectual property for basic human amino acid production

unasked_questions.question: What happens to the human gut microbiome after three generations of consuming purely precision-fermented nutrients?
Who owns the genetic blueprints when staple human calories become proprietary software code?
